heading.en: How sharply do two lines cross?

hook.en: Two flyovers pass over each other in space without meeting. We can still ask what angle one makes with the other: it is the angle between their directions.
hook.kn: ಎರಡು ಮೇಲ್ಸೇತುವೆಗಳು ಸಂಧಿಸದೆ ಒಂದರ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಹಾದುಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಆದರೂ ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ ಕೇಳಬಹುದು: ಅದು ಅವುಗಳ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ.

objectives.en: Find the angle between two lines from their direction ratios
Test lines for perpendicularity and parallelism
Use the vector form of the angle formula

narration.en: Two flyovers pass over each other in space without meeting. We can still ask what angle one makes with the other: it is the angle between their directions.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ಮೇಲ್ಸೇತುವೆಗಳು ಸಂಧಿಸದೆ ಒಂದರ ಮೇಲೊಂದು ಹಾದುಹೋಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಆದರೂ ಅವುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ ಕೇಳಬಹುದು: ಅದು ಅವುಗಳ ದಿಕ್ಕುಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ.

body.en: The angle between two lines is the angle between their direction vectors. With direction ratios $a_1, b_1, c_1$ and $a_2, b_2, c_2$, the acute angle is given by the formula below. With direction cosines it is simply $\cos\theta = |l_1l_2 + m_1m_2 + n_1n_2|$. In vector form, $\cos\theta = \frac{|\vec b_1\cdot\vec b_2|}{|\vec b_1||\vec b_2|}$.
body.kn: ಎರಡು ರೇಖೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ ಅವುಗಳ ದಿಕ್ ಸದಿಶಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ. cos θ = |a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂| / (√(a₁² + b₁² + c₁²) √(a₂² + b₂² + c₂²)).

points.en: Use only the direction parts, not the points
The modulus gives the acute angle

narration.en: The angle between two lines is the angle between their direction vectors. Take the dot product of the direction ratios, divide by the two lengths, and take the absolute value to get the acute angle.
narration.kn: ಎರಡು ರೇಖೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ ಅವುಗಳ ದಿಕ್ ಸದಿಶಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ. cos θ = |a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂| / (√(a₁² + b₁² + c₁²) √(a₂² + b₂² + c₂²)).

body.en: Two lines are perpendicular if $a_1a_2 + b_1b_2 + c_1c_2 = 0$. They are parallel if $\frac{a_1}{a_2} = \frac{b_1}{b_2} = \frac{c_1}{c_2}$.
body.kn: a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂ = 0 ಆದರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಲಂಬ. a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ ಆದರೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ.

narration.en: If the dot product of the direction ratios is zero, the lines are perpendicular. If the direction ratios are proportional, the lines are parallel.
narration.kn: a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂ = 0 ಆದರೆ ರೇಖೆಗಳು ಲಂಬ. a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂ ಆದರೆ ಸಮಾಂತರ.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. Find the angle between (x + 3)/3 = (y − 1)/5 = (z + 3)/4 and (x + 1)/1 = (y − 4)/1 = (z − 5)/2.

problem.en: Find p so that (1 − x)/3 = (7y − 14)/(2p) = (z − 3)/2 and (7 − 7x)/(3p) = (y − 5)/1 = (6 − z)/5 are perpendicular.

points.kn: ರೇಖೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ = ಅವುಗಳ ದಿಕ್ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ.

Perpendicular: a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂ = 0. Parallel: ratios proportional.

narration.en: Recap. The angle between lines is the angle between their direction ratios. cos θ = |a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂| / (product of the magnitudes). Perpendicular: a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂ = 0. Parallel: ratios proportional.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ರೇಖೆಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ = ಅವುಗಳ ದಿಕ್ ಅನುಪಾತಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಕೋನ. cos θ = |a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂| / (ಪರಿಮಾಣಗಳ ಗುಣಲಬ್ಧ). ಲಂಬ: a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ + c₁c₂ = 0. ಸಮಾಂತರ: ಅನುಪಾತಗಳು ಸಮ.
